pages.text:
The fastest farm: no soil, the roots hang in Nutrient Solution under a grow lamp. It grows 6 times as fast as the Glass Cloche.
- 48 FE/t while it grows, and 50 mB of Nutrient Solution a harvest.
- Carbon Dioxide is optional: with it in its gas tank it grows 1.25 times faster again, using 1 mB/t. Pipe it in with Pressurized Conduits through an input face (the top, by default, like its items and Nutrient Solution).
- Fertilizer still helps. Speed and Energy upgrades work.

# What only it grows
- Saplings: 6 logs, and sometimes a sapling, sticks and (oak) apples. About 50 s each.
- Flowers: 2 of the flower each harvest.
- Hops: 2 Hop Cones a harvest, no trellis needed.
It also grows everything the Glass Cloche does, nether wart and cactus included, without any soil.
Nutrient Solution comes from the Chemical Reactor: NPK Fertilizer and water.
